instance.name: uniform-0000500-1
instance.coordinate_check: The original JSON coordinate literals are finite decimal values with integer values. The checker reads them as Decimal and converts only exact integers.
instance.geometry_audit: An exact integer determinant scan of all 20,708,500 point triples found no collinear triple in this fixed instance.

problem_definition_source.author: Hadrien Cambazard
problem_definition_source.title: Minimum convex partition problem
problem_definition_source.definition: Partition the point-set convex hull into empty convex polygons whose extreme points belong to the input, with pairwise disjoint interiors; minimize the number of internal faces.

optimality_status_source.statement: The page says 100-point data sets are solved to optimality and lower bounds can be computed up to 300 points. It gives no optimality proof for this 500-point instance.

public_solution.solver_and_ai_provenance: Not stated in the archived solution metadata.

local_human_method.method: SciPy Delaunay triangulation plus deterministic greedy merging whenever two adjacent faces have a convex union.
local_human_method.method_source: Eder, Held, de Lorenzo, and Palfrader, CG:SHOP 2020, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.SoCG.2020.85, section 2.2, pages 85:2-3, describes a Delaunay triangulation followed by randomized edge removal while preserving convexity.
local_human_method.status: AI-assisted local reconstruction of the traditional method, using deterministic edge/merge ordering. It is not the paper's code or reported score and is not a published 500-point record.
